title: Invariants and coinvariants of G-equivariant (co)sheaves
body_html:
Invariants and coinvariants of $G$-equivariant (co)sheaves

Let $G$ act cellularly on $X$, $\mathscr{V} \in \Cosh_G(X, R)$, and let $K$ (resp.\ $K^+$) be a cosheaf (resp.\ sheaf) of subgroups of $G$ with $K_x \subseteq \Fix_G(x)$ (resp.\ $K_{x,+} \subseteq \Fix_G(x)$) for every $x$.

Lemma. Both $$E \mapsto (\mathscr{V}_E)_{K_E}, \qquad E \mapsto (\mathscr{V}_E)^{K_E^+}$$ are objects of $\Cosh_G(X, R)$.

Dually, for $\mathscr{V} \in \Sh_G(X, R)$, $$E \mapsto (\mathscr{V}_E)^{K_E}, \qquad E \mapsto (\mathscr{V}_E)_{K_E^+}$$ are objects of $\Sh_G(X, R)$.

The restriction and equivariance maps descend functorially because $K_E \trianglelefteq \Fix_G(E)$ and $r^\mathscr{V}_{E,E'}$ is $\Fix_G(E)$-equivariant on stalks. These constructions are the source of the "type-isotypic" cosheaves $\mathscr{V}[\phi]$ used in The subcategory Rep_φ(G) and Coeff_G(B(Σ), Φ) with axioms (EC1)–(EC4).
